title: Emerging applications and mechanistic insights of copper mediated electrocatalysts in organic transformations
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00382B, Review Article
Masnun Naher, Miguel A. Gonzálvez, Craig M. Williams, Paul V. Bernhardt
This review covers electrosynthesis mediated Cu-catalysed organic reaction methodology, with a focus on C–C, C–N and C–X bond formation. Mechanistic details are also discussed as part of this emerging area of synthetic methodology.
